title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and collection policies for Intune-protected mobile apps
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned mobile integration from existing Intune and Purview controls. The roadmap dates, documented roles and existing clipboard API are supported; searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in mobile configuration and licensing. The collection-policy route could be extended beyond the policy list.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans integrated, content-aware Purview DLP protection for Intune MAM-protected mobile apps.
claims.quote: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling organizations to apply content-aware protection policies to sensitive data on mobile devices.
